item.title: „Ein informierter Kryptoanleger setzt nur Kapital ein, das er aussitzen kann“
item.author: FAZ.NET
item.description: Bitpanda ist Europas größtes Kryptowährungsunternehmen, gegründet im Jahr 2014 in Wien mit der Idee, das Investieren in Bitcoin und andere digitale Assets so einfach wie möglich zu machen – und das für jedermann. Über die Jahre haben wir uns weiterentwickelt und bieten unseren Kunden heute neben mehr als 700 Kryptowährungen auch Aktien und ETF an.

item.title: Nvidia’s Show of Financial Force Soothes Credit Markets
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The company will support some projects by guaranteeing as much as 25%, using something known as a residual value mechanism to help limit losses if a project runs into trouble. The company didn’t provide much detail, but said its chips can be used by a wide array of its customers, which can presumably help minimize Nvidia’s losses.

item.title: Segantii Alum’s Hedge Fund Firm Grew Assets, Gained in July
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: A hedge fund firm founded by a former Segantii Capital Management portfolio manager has grown its assets to $680 million after attracting a new client and chalking up gains during the July market selloff, according to an update sent to investors. The hedge fund of Viridian Asset Management, set up by Pascal Guttieres, returned 2.65% in July, with about 75% of that coming from equity capital markets trades, it said.
